description: The docs publish GET /zones/{zone_id}/snippets/snippet_rules twice (RulesGet + RulesList), and distilled exports it as getRule (errors: []) with listRules as the richer duplicate declaring [SnippetRulesNotFound, Forbidden]. The route-dedup keeps getRule and aliases listRules to it, losing the typed errors — so a zone with no snippet rules surfaces generic NotFound ('could not find entrypoint ruleset in the http_request_snippets phase') instead of SnippetRulesNotFound, which alchemy's provider catches by tag. Attach the union of both duplicates' error lists.
